[[File:Generations_newsfeed_banner.jpg|thumb|400x400px|"Getting back was only the beginning."]] '''Generations''' is a Chrono-Vector [[Special Mission]] that ran from Sept 12th to Sept 25th.

== Synopsis ==
''Wheeljack and Jetfire have teamed up to monitor “Chrono-Vector” effects. To better research timeline disturbances, they have found a way to generate moments from all the Bots from their origin point. They’ll need the help of the Commander as they gather samples from EVERY Generation 1 Bot on New Quintessa! Get ready for a blast from the past as you enter '''CHRONO-VECTOR: GENERATIONS.'''''

''This is a brand new Challenge Mission with 4 difficulties (from 2-Star to 5-Star) and will feature Bot specific Mods for an increased challenge! It will be available Sept 12th at 10am PDT - Sept 25th at 10am PDT.''

== Overview ==
Each Map features 6 themed Bots for a total of 24 encounters! Mission Rewards include GENERATION [[Chips|CHIPS]] which can be used to acquire Generation 1 Bots in the Store.

Out of the Generations Bots encountered in this mission, [[Windblade]], [[Kickback]], [[Megatronus]], and [[Nemesis Prime]] are not present.

== Transcript ==

=== Evil Forces ===
Part 1
* [[Jetfire]]: ''Wheeljack, I've altered your Chrono-Vector Device to analyze fractures from our timeline.''
* [[Wheeljack]]: ''That why you got the Autobot and Decepticon crews all standing around?''
* Jetfire: ''What you see are Chrono-Anomalies. By battling them we can ping their Chrono-Reference-Alignment-Parameters.''
* Wheeljack: ''Yeah...I'm just going to call them Time-Slices.''
* Jetfire: ''If you must. We should begin our research immediately.''
* Wheeljack: ''Fighting and learning, sounds up my alley! Let's start with some Decepticons!''
Part 2
* [[Shockwave]]: ''Prepare for termination!''
Part 3
* [[Soundwave]]: ''Escape is impossible! Autobots inferior, Soundwave superior!''
Part 4
* [[Megatron]]: ''Everything I touch is food for my hunger. My hunger for power!''
* Wheeljack: ''Hey Jetfire, the Time-Slices keep shouting at me!''
* Jetfire: ''Each interaction with them pierces a unique Chrono-Vector, it is possible we were mid-conversation before we engage them.''
* Wheeljack: ...''Knowing why somehow makes it worse.''

=== No Place to Run ===
Part 1
* Jetfire: ''We must engage with Autobot-Vectors.''
* Wheeljack: ''Seems we've got a road race to join.''
* Jetfire: ''Indeed. We must be quick, and don't hold back.''
* Wheeljack: ''So to be clear, you want this drag race to be fast AND...''
* Jetfire: ''Fully within the parameters of our experiment.''
* Wheeljack: ''Never going to launch a franchise with that title.''
Part 2
* [[Ratchet]]: ''No more backtalk, or I'll short your mouth circuit.''
Part 3
* [[Mirage]]: ''Sorry Prime, the ship was full!''
Part 4
* [[Bumblebee]]: ''Prime told me there'd be days like this.''
* Wheeljack: ''And you didn't believe him?''
* Jetfire: (hitting Wheeljack on the head) ''Wheeljack, they can't interact with you like that.''
* Wheeljack: Ow! ''Sorry, it just felt so familiar! Alright, let's rumble Bumble!''

=== From the Sky Above ===
Part 1
* Jetfire: ''The road is clear, time to take on some of the Decepticons in the sky.''
* Wheeljack: ''There's a familiar face right in front of us.''
* Jetfire: ''Indeed! It appears that one of my own..Time-Slices...has materialized.''
* Wheeljack: ''Well, I'll just go up there and punch you as hard as I can.''
* Jetfire: ''For science?''
* Wheeljack: ''...yeah. Science.''
Part 2
* [[Starscream]]: ''Megatron has fallen! I, Starscream, am now your new leader!''
Part 3
* [[Cyclonus]]: ''Warriors such as you and I should meet their end in battle.''
Part 4
* [[Galvatron]]: ''Cybertron and all its moons belong to me!''
* Wheeljack: ''There's a lot of ego on these guys, huh?''
* Jetfire: ''I am here to analyze the impossibly complex chrono-vectors of our timelines, not their mental states.''
* Wheeljack: ''I'm writing down that they're jerks.''
* Jetfire: ''Remain scientific and impartial, Wheeljack.''
* Wheeljack: ''Fine. I'll just shoot them a bunch.''
* Jetfire: ''That is preferable for our research, thank you.''

=== Wage Their Battle ===
Part 1
* Wheeljack: ''One more group of Autobots to get through.''
* Jetfire: ''I see your Time-Slice in the distance, when we reach it shall I take care of the battle?''
* Wheeljack: ''N'ah, I've always wanted to know if I could beat me in a fair fight.''
* Jetfire: ''How would fighting yourself be ... not fair?''
* Wheeljack: ''I'm a complicated Bot. Also...I fight dirty.''
Part 2
* [[Grimlock]]: ''ME GRIMLOCK KING!''
Part 3
* [[Jazz]]: ''Do it with style or don't bother doing it.''
Part 4 - finale
* [[Optimus Prime]]: ''So long as freedom exists. We shall remember you...''
* Jetfire: ''...curious.''
* Wheeljack: ''What's up Jetfire?''
* Jetfire: ''Nothing. It...it was just an odd moment to recall. We need to finish this research.''
* Wheeljack: ''More data coming up. Go get him Commander!''

== Trivia ==
* Much like [[Prime Suspect]]'s chapter names this Mission's names are a reference to ''The Transformers: The Movie'', this time Lion's rendition of the ''Transformers'' theme song.
* The title images with Wheeljack and Jetfire parody ''Back to the Future.''
* This mission's dialogue snippets are pulled from various G1 episodes:<ref>[https://forums.transformersforgedtofight.com/discussion/comment/95905/#Comment_95905 This post by the user Technobot]</ref>
** From the "More Than Meets the Eye" pilot: Megatron, Mirage, Bumblebee.
** From "S.O.S. Dinobots": Starscream.<ref>[https://forums.transformersforgedtofight.com/discussion/comment/95907/#Comment_95907 This post by the user ScarredArachnid333]</ref>
** From "Fire in the Sky": Optimus Prime.
** From "The Ultimate Doom" three-parter: Shockwave.
** From the movie: Grimlock, Galvatron.
** From "The Killing Jar": Cyclonus.
